description: I am interested in astronomy, space exploration, and Mars. I want to explore NASA data and create a useful interactive map to help people understand the Martian surface and plan future exploration. I am eager to learn new skills and develop my own scientific project.

details:
Mars Explorer Map

Mars Explorer Map is an interactive web-based platform designed to make exploring Mars easier, more interesting, and more accessible.

The project allows users to explore Mars through an interactive map, discover different locations, and examine scientific information about the planet. It includes map layers, exploration features, educational content, and a quiz that helps users learn more about Mars.

The main goal of this project is to bring planetary exploration closer to students, astronomy enthusiasts, and anyone interested in space science. By combining an interactive map with educational information, the platform encourages curiosity, independent learning, and a better understanding of Mars.

My project could help users become more familiar with the Martian surface, understand why certain locations are scientifically interesting, and discover how mapping tools can support planetary research and future exploration missions.

I developed the project independently using Replit and AI-assisted coding tools. During development, I focused on creating a clear interface, simple navigation, useful interactive features, and a design inspired by professional space exploration platforms.

I wanted Mars Explorer Map to be more than a presentation or a game. My idea was to create a platform where users can actively explore, discover, and learn.

One planet, many questions.

AI tools, including ChatGPT and Replit AI, were used to assist with brainstorming, coding, debugging, and project development. The project concept, feature choices, and creative direction were developed by me.
